dropped.PMO goal-directed molecular design (osim: Not implemented. The oracle is a public closed-form RDKit function (GuacaMol/TDC definitions) and the task name identifies the target, so a candidate program can recompute it locally and search without limit; the 10,000-call oracle budget that defines PMO's AUC top-10 metric cannot be enforced in a program-search setting. Published values (Gao et al. 2022; Kim et al. 2024) were read but no task was built.
dropped.TDC ADMET benchmark group (Caco-2, lipop: Blocked: the Harvard Dataverse storage redirect refused connections; replaced by the Biogen ADME endpoints.
dropped.(NaCl)_N Cl- clusters with the Tosi-Fumi: Dropped: with the Tosi-Fumi parameters as published, relaxed structures reproduce the tabulated energies only to about 0.001-0.004 eV (three published decimals), and the exact parameter set used by the authors could not be checked, so exact references cannot be guaranteed.
dropped.Binary Lennard-Jones and (C60)_N Pacheco: Dropped: binary LJ energies are published only in the unreachable Cambridge Cluster Database, and the PPR potential's functional form is in a paper that could not be read, so energies could not be verified.
dropped.Morse clusters at rho = 14: Excluded from the Morse task: Doye, Leary, Locatelli and Schoen (2004) report new minima at rho = 14 that could not be read.
dropped.Sutton-Chen 12-6 N = 68, 10-8 N = 58 and: Excluded: Lopez-Castro et al. (2024) report lower minima than the database for the first two and could not reproduce the third.
dropped.Matbench glass, mp_gap, mp_e_form, mp_is: Not used: glass labels come from a Landolt-Bornstein volume with unclear licensing; the Materials Project tasks have more than 100,000 structures, beyond the CPU budget; log_kvrh nearly duplicates log_gvrh.
dropped.Biogen hPPB and rPPB endpoints: Not used: the official split files contain about ten times more compounds than the public set lists for these endpoints, so their provenance could not be checked.
dropped.Kinetic parameter estimation benchmarks: Not implemented: the published optima are five or fewer numbers that a candidate can return from memory, so the score would not measure estimation methods.
